note: Median months from receipt to completion for employment-based I-485s, one figure per fiscal year. These are ANNUAL MEDIANS: the spread between years is movement in the median, not the spread between individual cases, which is wider. Must not be presented as percentiles for one applicant.
why_this_is_not_the_visa_wait: Retrogressed cases are excluded from the figures, so what is measured is time to decide a case that could be decided rather than time spent waiting for a visa number. The queue wait is modelled separately, from the bulletin.
exclusion_note: Processing times are defined as the number of months it took for an application, petition, or request to be processed from receipt to completion in a given time period. Visa regressed I-485s and revoked petitions or applications are excluded.
